name: Camping Stove
description: Guidelines for traveling with camping stove in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Camping stoves are allowed in carry-on only if they are completely empty and clean of all fuel residue or odors.

checkedBag.reason: Camping stoves are allowed in checked bags only if completely clean of all fuel residue and odors. Even slight fumes will cause confiscation.

travelTips: Camping stoves are allowed in carry-on only if they are completely empty and clean of all fuel residue or odors.

faq.question: Is camping stove allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Camping Stove is allowed in carry-on luggage. Camping stoves are allowed in carry-on only if they are completely empty and clean of all fuel residue or odors.

faq.question: Can you pack camping stove in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Camping Stove is allowed in checked bags. Camping stoves are allowed in checked bags only if completely clean of all fuel residue and odors. Even slight fumes will cause confiscation.
